title: "city.infra"
subtitle: "Open network tools and data for Hobart, Tasmania"
toc: false
---

A working space for applying open urban-analysis tooling to Hobart, with an
eye to contributions that have the most positive social impact, in
collaboration with the [UrbanAnalyst](https://github.com/UrbanAnalyst) project.

## Tools

[**Segment mapper**](mapper.qmd)
: Find street sections by name and cross street (`Argyle [Federal, Burnett]`),
  select network segments on the map, and save them as named groupings that
  describe the quality, accessibility or experience of local infrastructure.
  Runs entirely in the browser; groupings stay on your device until you export
  them as CSV.

## Data

- [tas-transport-web](https://source.coop/mdsumner/tas-transport-web): the
  statewide LIST transport network as web-ready GeoParquet and PMTiles
  (EPSG:4326, endpoint node ids, dated snapshots).
- [thelist-opendata](https://source.coop/mdsumner/thelist-opendata): a
  cloud-native mirror of every LIST open data product, as GeoParquet and COG
  ([code](https://github.com/hypertidy/thelist-opendata)).

See [data provenance](data/README.md) for how each is built.
